sections.zh:
在历史的长河中我们早已遗忘我们的人民是如何来到[GetHomeWorldName]的。我们只知道在大约2000年前，一场难以置信的巨大灾变摧毁了环形世界的大部分，罹难者不计其数，而我们则从这片废墟当中站了起来。

我们的文明茁壮成长，如今已准备好探索星海——无论是初次，还是又一次如此。尽管我们已有了长足的进步，然而想要理解并修复我们的环形世界家园，仍然还有很长的路要走。
sections.en:
If we ever knew how our people arrived on [GetHomeWorldName] our histories have long forgotten it. What we do know is that just over 2000 years ago some inconceivable cataclysm destroyed much of the Ring and killed most of the population, and that our people eventually rose from those ruins.

Our civilization has grown, flourished, and now stands ready to explore the galaxy, whether again or for the first time. But despite all our progress, we still have a long way to go before we can understand and repair the Ringworld which is our home.

summary.text:
# 破碎之环 / Shattered Ring

- 分类 Category：起源 Origins · DLC：Federations · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`common/governments/civics/00_origins.txt:1912-1954`、`events/origin_events_3.txt:269-344`、`common/inline_scripts/game_start/origin_shattered_ring.txt`

> 本导读是审阅者的说明文字，不是游戏原文。 This guide is reviewer commentary, not game text.

## 如何开始 How it starts

起始殖民地为破碎之环的可居住段（pc_shattered_ring_habitable）；电力、采矿、农业区不设上限，采矿区 +2。开局隐藏事件 origin.3150 清理废弃环世界并在2700 / 5400天后生成可保证的殖民地（origin.3155 为AI补建殖民地）。
The homeworld is a habitable ring segment; energy, mining and farming districts are uncapped with +2 mining. Hidden origin.3150 removes the ruined ring and spawns the guaranteed colonies after 2700 / 5400 days; hidden origin.3155 fills AI colonies.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

没有玩家窗口；通用事件 country.900（隐藏）按该起源调整。
No player window; generic hidden country.900 adjusts for this origin.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无。 None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

可选条件见起源卡。 Requirements are on the origin card.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：起源定义、开局设置与全部事件目录中对该起源的引用。 The origin definition, its start setup and every reference to the origin in the events folder.
- 结论 Result：卡片型起源，没有专属事件窗口。 A card-only origin with no origin-specific windows.
